name: video-post
description: Automated post-production for talking-head course video. rough-cut removes dead air, filler words, false starts and botched takes from raw footage, measuring real silence from audio levels rather than guessing. slide-cutout puts presentation slides on screen with the speaker as a circular corner cutout, timed from spoken cue phrases instead of hand-entered timestamps. Both hand back editable FCP7 XML timelines that Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve import, never a locked-off render. Runs entirely locally via Whisper -- no cloud APIs, footage never leaves the machine. Built for creators cutting large course batches who do not want to scrub through 100 videos by hand.
